title: Direct Immutable Parameter/Forcing View Source-Bound Feasibility Disposition

geometry: configure_parameters refreshes all three arrays from fmr_b110_physical_parameters_t
hydraulics: raw input rows are copied into the worker buffer
derived B1.10/MvG rows 25:42 are recomputed into that worker buffer
forcing: worker model owns qdra/qssdi/qrot pointer targets allocated by the backend
prepare_interval refreshes those targets from forcing registry arrays
source/sink and root providers then bind read-only pointers to the worker-owned copies

blocking_contract_facts: kernel configure_parameters_iface receives class(kernel_parameters_t), intent(in) without an explicit target/view lifetime contract
canonical prepare_interval_iface receives class(canonical_forcing_t), intent(in) without an explicit target/view lifetime contract
the current callbacks do not state that a model may retain aliases to caller-owned objects after callback return
soil_water_parameter_set_t owns allocatable geometry arrays and validate_soil_water_request explicitly validates those owned allocatables
there is no versioned immutable registry object or generation token that proves a retained view remains valid and unchanged for the complete trial/retry lifetime

architecture_disposition.reason: It would create a hidden lifetime/mutation dependency on caller-owned registry storage, violating explicit ownership and no-silent-dependency invariants.
safe_future_shape: runtime-owned immutable parameter storage with explicit lifetime spanning all worker trials that reference it
runtime-owned immutable forcing snapshot/storage for the complete interval/coupling window
versioned/generation-bound view handles rather than raw undocumented pointer retention
shared immutable precomputed hydraulic parameter object for raw plus derived MvG coefficients, or worker-local derived cache with an explicit immutable raw view
solver request contract that distinguishes owned arrays from immutable views without changing physics
view invalidation only outside active trial/retry windows

invariant_check.04_compact_persistent_state: future immutable sharing is aligned, but no unsafe shortcut is admitted
invariant_check.05_scratch_per_worker: current worker-local derived/copy buffers remain compliant
invariant_check.06_scalable_memory_layout: opportunity identified, not yet safely realized
invariant_check.07_transactional_steps: retained views must remain stable through full trial/retry lifecycle
invariant_check.16_multiswap_primary: copy overhead is relevant, but correctness precedes optimization
invariant_check.29_no_silent_dependencies: PASS only because raw retained aliases are rejected under current callback contracts
invariant_check.30_architecture_change_tested: no production change admitted in F-PE10 feasibility phase

open: define explicit immutable registry/view lifetime contract
decide shared precomputed hydraulic parameter representation
only then implement and scientifically qualify zero-copy candidate
